'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[Catatumbo campaign]]
***The [[National Liberation Army (Colombia)|National Liberation Army]] deploys a [[drone warfare|drone]] to attack a [[Military Forces of Colombia|military]] convoy in [[Catatumbo region|Catatumbo]], [[Colombia]], killing three soldiers and injuring eight others. [https://apnews.com/article/colombia-drone-attack-eln-catatumbo-61768f71290d2604a2d123d017cb18b4 (AP)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]] and tanks enter [[Deir al-Balah]] in [[Deir al-Balah Governorate|central Gaza]] for the first time since the start of the war. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-sends-tanks-into-gazas-deir-al-balah-raising-concerns-among-hostage-2025-07-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***The [[United States]] and [[Germany]] agree to send five [[MIM-104 Patriot|Patriot missile defense systems]] to [[Ukraine]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/us-germany-agree-to-deliver-5-patriot-systems-to-ukraine/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')] 
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Southern Syria clashes (July 2025–present)|Southern Syria clashes]]
***Hundreds of [[Bedouin]] civilians are evacuated from [[Suwayda]], [[Syria]], as part of a ceasefire following clashes that left hundreds dead. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/bedouin-civilians-evacuate-syrias-sweida-tense-truce-holds-2025-07-21/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Dhaka fighter jet crash]]
**At least 31 people are killed and more than 50 others are injured after a [[Bangladesh Air Force]] [[List of Chengdu J-7 variants#F-7BGI|FT-7BGI]] [[training aircraft]] crashes into a college and school campus in [[Uttara (neighbourhood)|Uttara]], [[Dhaka]], [[Bangladesh]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/7/21/bangladesh-air-force-plane-crashes-into-college-campus-killing-at-least-19 (AlJazeera)]
*[[2025 Pacific typhoon season]]
**At least 22 people are killed and more than 90,000 people are displaced as [[Tropical Storm Wipha (2025)|Tropical Storm Wipha]] hits the [[Philippines]] and [[South Korea]]. [https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/400-flights-affected-22-killed-as-typhoon-wipha-batters-china-south-korea-vietnam-philippines-1.500205234 (''Gulf News'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[El Salvador–Venezuela relations]]
**The [[Venezuela]]n [[Public Ministry of Venezuela|attorney general's office]] opens a formal investigation into [[El Salvador|Salvadoran]] [[President of El Salvador|president]] [[Nayib Bukele]] and his [[Government of El Salvador|government's]] alleged mistreatment of Venezuelan migrants detained in the United States and sent to the [[CECOT]] megaprison, built to hold alleged [[Salvadoran gang crackdown|gang members]]. [https://apnews.com/article/venezuela-el-salvador-migrants-prisoners-a13efd9b87d9ce30c3b3ee45e0253745 (AP)]

*[[Jagdeep Dhankhar]] resigns as the [[Vice President of India]] citing health reasons. [https://www.ndtv.com/video/jagdeep-dhankhar-resigns-as-vice-president-expresses-gratitude-to-pm-969332 (NDTV)]
